language.notice.showing.description: Notice shown once after Homeroom picked the device's language automatically. {{language}} is that language's own name, for example Español.

language.notice.dismiss.description: Accessible label of the close button on the automatic-language notice.

language.notice.switchToEnglish.description: Button on the automatic-language notice. Always shown in English, whatever language is active, so a person who cannot read the picked language can find it.
